t: Did you hear about the new coffee shop downtown?
My roommate said it was good.
No, but I was thinking we could go there for our study group on Saturday, you know, since the library is being renovated and won't be open until next week.
But I can't go to the study group this weekend.
My brother is coming to visit and I'm showing him around.
Let me know how it is though.
I always love to try new coffee shops.
